critique.evidence: Measured results are demo-ready across all three viewports: FCP 52–76 ms, LCP 548–704 ms, TTFB 1.3–5.8 ms, and load/DCL 141–237 ms. CLS is 0 on mobile, 0.001 on desktop, and a still-low 0.0478 on tablet. Mobile/tablet frame timing holds near 16.67 ms with no long frames; desktop has no long frames but averages 20.73 ms and peaks at 33.4 ms. There are no console, page, or request failures and no horizontal overflow. The main limitation is payload size: 1,148,898 JS bytes and 1,314,022 transferred bytes across 17 requests.
critique.fix: Reduce the roughly 1.15 MB JavaScript bundle through route-level code splitting and dead-code removal, and profile the desktop interaction path responsible for the 20.73 ms average frame time. Also reserve or stabilize tablet layout regions to reduce CLS from 0.0478 toward zero.
